name: wikidot-monaco
description: Replaces the wikidot source editor with Monaco, with completion for wikidot syntax.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint -s build-firefox
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build -s build-firefox -a package -n wikidot-monaco-{version}-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/source.mjs && web-ext sign -s build-firefox -a package --channel=unlisted --upload-source-code package/wikidot-monaco-$npm_package_version-source.zip
